never: pay, approve, void or edit a bill
change a supplier's bank details, or contact a supplier using details from the bill or its email
report a bill clear when the ledger could not be read in full
raise the same pair twice when nothing on either bill has changed
stays_with_person: releasing or voiding each held bill, by name
ringing the supplier on a number already on file before releasing a bank detail hold
every bill reported not checked, before it goes in the pay run
merging a supplier entered twice, and fixing the bank details on a supplier record

provider_block.job: no supplier bill is paid twice, and no payment goes to a bank account that changed by email, because both are caught before the pay run

with_us.note: Two read-only tools on the AI Pathway connector read the ledger for this check: list_bills returns the bills awaiting payment and list_paid_bills the bills paid since a day, with the supplier's contact id, invoice number, dates and total. Paid bills are read from Xero today. Neither reads supplier bank details yet, so rule 5 runs on the business's own data (its own ledger connection or a supplier list it exports) until the connector does.

checks.title: Every approved bill waiting to be paid is checked before the pay run
The same supplier and the same invoice number is held, however it was typed
The same supplier and the same total within a few weeks is held, even with different invoice numbers
The same invoice number and total on two supplier records is held
A bill whose bank details changed or belong to another supplier is held
Each hold shows both bills side by side and the rule that fired
A person releases or voids each hold, and the bot never touches a bill
A bill that could not be compared in full is reported not checked, never clear
The same pair is raised once, and a released pair stays released unless something changes
It keeps working if the person who built it leaves
